title: Pumpkin Lantern Night in the Tiny Town
altTitles: Carving Tiny Pumpkins for the Autumn Lantern Parade
A Cozy Autumn Market in a Miniature Town
description:
Autumn market day in Thimble Town: choosing pea-sized pumpkins, carving, pumpkin broth and apple tarts, then a lantern parade at dusk. Wordless miniature ASMR.
